title: Tight Entropic Uncertainty Relations
summary: Entropic uncertainty relations $H(A)+H(B)\geqslant γ$ give a nonzero lower bound $γ$ to the sum of the Shannon entropies $H$ of the outcome probabilities of incompatible observables $A$ and $B$. They are better than the variance-based uncertainty relations because they only depend on the Born statistics of the outcomes and not on the outcomes themselves, and because bounds $γ$ typically are state independent.
